title: Update on Return to Work Programme and Number of Workers Helped
what_it_is: Update on Return to Work Programme and Number of Workers Helped

sections.label: RTW services at public hospitals
sections.summary: RTW services are available at seven public hospitals.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Manpower (Mr Zaqy Mohamad) (for the Minister for Manpower)
sentences.text: RTW services are available at seven public hospitals.

sections.label: RTW participation and placement outcomes
sections.summary: As of end 2019, 1922 injured workers participated, about 95% were placed back to work, an improvement from around 75%.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Manpower (Mr Zaqy Mohamad) (for the Minister for Manpower)
sentences.text: As of end 2019, 1922 injured workers have participated in the programme.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Manpower (Mr Zaqy Mohamad) (for the Minister for Manpower)
sentences.text: About 95% of the participants have been successfully placed back to work.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Manpower (Mr Zaqy Mohamad) (for the Minister for Manpower)
sentences.text: This was an improvement from around 75% remaining employed before the RTW programme.

sections.label: Participation rate and non-participation reasons
sections.summary: About 64% of suitable injured workers participate, with non-participation mostly due to worker resignation or employer dismissal.

sentences.speaker: Mr Zaqy Mohamad
sentences.text: First, we have about 64% of suitable injured workers participating in the Return to Work programme.

sentences.speaker: Mr Zaqy Mohamad
sentences.text: For those who did not participate, it was mostly because either the worker resigned or the employer dismissed the worker.

sections.label: RTW hospital expansion and KK exception
sections.summary: RTW service is available at seven public hospitals, each an A&E hospital, with KK Hospital the only A&E exception.

sentences.speaker: Mr Zaqy Mohamad
sentences.text: On the Member's second question with regard to whether we will expand the number of hospitals, right now, the Return to Work service is already available at seven public hospitals and each one is an A&E hospital.

sentences.speaker: Mr Zaqy Mohamad
sentences.text: The only exception today that has an A&E that is not part of the programme is KK Hospital, as mentioned earlier.
